project.name: Widget Annotation Processor
project.description:
Does at compile time what GWT's generators do through deferred binding, so the TeaVM backend gets the same features without a generator SPI.
It runs inside javac, which is what makes it worth having: the questions a UiBinder generator has to answer are questions about types -- does this widget have a @UiConstructor, what does this setter take, is that type an enum -- and javac already knows the answers. Reading them from the annotation processing type model is exact where scanning sources for them is guesswork.
